title: Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program

scheme.name: Assistance to Farmers for Mini Tractor and Power Tiller in Farm Mechanization Program
scheme.summary: The scheme aims to improve agricultural productivity and reduce manual labor burden by providing financial assistance for the purchase of mini tractors and power tillers to farmers.
eligibility: The applicant should be a farmer.
The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
The applicant should be engaged in agricultural practices and require mechanization support.
The applicant should intend to purchase either a mini tractor up to 20 HP, or a power tiller (either above or below 8 BHP).
scheme.benefits: Financial assistance/subsidy for mini tractors and power tillers based on equipment horsepower and category of the farmer.
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online at the I-Khedut Portal by registering/logging in, selecting the scheme, applying, and confirming the application.
